answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the plume log shows the live set and the forge audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 645 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 203 aliases alive hence means 203 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the walnut quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. That is 35 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
